# Phase 06 tuning (generated by `analysis/tuning_report.py`)

Protocol after D-003: 125M model, 2,500 steps of 240 × 1024 tokens (614M tokens), seeds 0 and 1, selection on the mean final loss over the full 20M-token validation split; Stage A learning-rate grid (7 points, factor 2, edge extensions offered to every optimizer), Stage C one secondary knob (3 values). Driver `scripts/tpu/tune.py`, one frozen code snapshot (`/home/tasma/gimbal_snapshots/tuning`).
